I have implemented the type-safe SQL window functions API and named window support across all dialects on the `feat/window-functions` branch.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Window Functions & Frame Builders ([window.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), [index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/index.ts))**
   - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L283-L285), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L287-L289), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L291-L293), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L295-L298), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L300-L302), [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L304-L306).
   - **Offset / value-access helpers**: [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L329-L361), [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L384-L416), [`firstValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L418-L422), [`lastValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L424-L428), [`nthValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L430-L435) — typed nullable by default, with `lag` and `lead` stripping `null` when a default value is supplied.
   - **Window aggregates**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L441-L443), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L445-L447), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L449-L453), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L455-L459), [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L461-L466) (emitting `count(*)` when called with no argument).
   - **Frame utilities**: [`rows`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L156-L158), [`range`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L160-L162), [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L98-L103), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L105-L110), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L112-L117), [`preceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L119-L126), and [`following`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L128-L135).
   - **Builder**: [`WindowFunction`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L225-L277) with `.over(spec | windowName)` supporting inline `PARTITION BY`, `ORDER BY`, frame clauses, empty `OVER ()`, or named window references (`OVER "name"` without parentheses).
   - **Validation & Raw Literals**: Numeric positional offsets (`ntile`, `nthValue`, `lag`, `lead`, `preceding`, `following`) are emitted via `sql.raw` rather than bound query parameters, and validated according to all constraints.

2. **Dialect Select Builders & `WINDOW` Clause Compilation**
   - Added chainable `.window(name, spec)` to select query builders and `WINDOW` clause compilation prior to `ORDER BY` across:
     - PostgreSQL ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/query-builders/select.ts), [select.types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/query-builders/select.types.ts), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/dialect.ts))
     - MySQL ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/query-builders/select.ts), [select.types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/query-builders/select.types.ts), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/dialect.ts))
     - SQLite ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/query-builders/select.ts), [select.types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/query-builders/select.types.ts), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/dialect.ts))
     - SingleStore ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/query-builders/select.ts), [select.types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/query-builders/select.types.ts), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/dialect.ts))
     - Gel ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/query-builders/select.ts), [select.types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/query-builders/select.types.ts), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/dialect.ts))

3. **Tests ([window.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mapudu9f/drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts))**
   - Added unit and type tests covering all window helpers, frame boundaries, validation errors, dialect quoting, named windows, and return type inference.
